story_summary: 週の折り返し水曜日、午後の仕事中にラーメンのことしか考えられなくなるぽん。「ご褒美」の定義がどんどん緩くなっていく。

panels.scene: オフィスのデスクでPCに向かうぽん。壁掛けカレンダーの水曜日に赤丸がついている。窓の外には新緑が見える。時計は14時を指している。
panels.pon_expression: 真剣な顔でPCを見つめている、仕事モード
panels.dialogue:
水曜日…週の折り返し…
ここを乗り越えれば…！
panels.chatgpt_prompt: watercolor anime style, soft warm colors, manga panel border, clean line art. Japanese office lady in her early 20s, short black bob hair with a small ahoge, big brown eyes, light blue button-up shirt, dark navy slacks. She is sitting at her office desk staring at a PC monitor with a serious determined expression. A wall calendar showing Wednesday circled in red. Clock showing 2 PM. Fresh green leaves visible through the office window, late spring atmosphere. 4-panel manga, panel 1 of 4

panels.scene: ぽんの頭の中に浮かぶラーメンの妄想。湯気の立つ味噌ラーメンが輝いて見える。PCの画面にはExcelが映っているが、目線は完全に虚空。
panels.pon_expression: 目がキラキラ、よだれをこらえている、頬が紅潮
panels.dialogue:
頑張った自分へのご褒美に
今日はラーメン食べよ…♡
panels.chatgpt_prompt: watercolor anime style, soft warm colors, manga panel border, clean line art. Japanese office lady in her early 20s, short black bob hair with a small ahoge, big brown eyes, light blue button-up shirt, dark navy slacks. She is at her desk but her eyes are sparkling and dreamy, slightly drooling, blushing cheeks. A thought bubble shows a glowing bowl of rich miso ramen with steam rising. Excel spreadsheet visible on her monitor but she is clearly not focused. Late spring green trees outside window. 4-panel manga, panel 2 of 4

panels.scene: 同僚の女性が呆れた顔でぽんに話しかける。ぽんはハッとした表情。同僚がスマホの画面を見せている（ぽんのSNS投稿履歴）。
panels.pon_expression: ギクッとした表情、冷や汗
panels.dialogue:
同僚「ぽんちゃん…月曜も火曜も
同じこと言ってたよ？」

ぽん「えっ」
panels.chatgpt_prompt: watercolor anime style, soft warm colors, manga panel border, clean line art. Japanese office lady in her early 20s, short black bob hair with a small ahoge, big brown eyes, light blue button-up shirt, dark navy slacks. She looks shocked and caught off guard with sweat drops, frozen expression. A female coworker with brown ponytail hair stands next to her showing a smartphone screen with social media posts. The smartphone screen shows multiple ramen photos posted on consecutive days. Office background with fresh green trees outside, late spring Wednesday atmosphere. 4-panel manga, panel 3 of 4

panels.scene: ぽんがキリッとした顔で立ち上がり、指を一本立てて力説している。同僚は完全に呆れている。背景に「月：週始めのご褒美」「火：火曜を乗り越えたご褒美」「水：折り返しのご褒美」とテキストが並ぶ。
panels.pon_expression: ドヤ顔、自信満々、キリッとした目
panels.dialogue:
「毎日が何かしらの
折り返しだから！！」
panels.chatgpt_prompt: watercolor anime style, soft warm colors, manga panel border, clean line art. Japanese office lady in her early 20s, short black bob hair with a small ahoge, big brown eyes, light blue button-up shirt, dark navy slacks. She is standing up proudly from her desk chair with a confident smug expression, pointing one finger up dramatically. Her coworker is in the background with a completely exasperated face and slumped shoulders. Background text bubbles listing excuses: Monday reward, Tuesday reward, Wednesday reward. Office setting with late spring greenery visible outside, warm afternoon light. 4-panel manga, panel 4 of 4
